profile: loss function: In optimization, a loss function is defined to optimize. Formalizing a learning task raises the question of how to define it. One presented form is l(w) = 1/n Σ (x̃_i^T w - y_i)^2, the average squared difference between a linear prediction x̃_i^T w and a target y_i. In this form, the loss depends on both the linear prediction and the target value.
